_meta.source: Derived from tests/promptfoo/niche-templates/home_renovation.yaml + Velly deep study + real reno-contractor configs

required.why: Agent identifies itself with this on every call.
Voice agent needs a name to introduce itself.
Every routed call needs a human to route to. Agent says 'I'll have <owner> call you back'.
Agent confirms 'do you cover X?' instantly without routing. Identity-tier answer.
Identity-tier answer. Also drives after-hours detection at call time.
Required for transferCall tool. Without it, the agent can't escalate live calls.

recommended.why: Most home_renovation owners tell their agent how to handle 'how much does it cost?' calls. Without this set, the agent defaults to 'let me check' on every pricing call.
Helps the agent cleanly answer 'what do you guys do?' and 'do you handle X?' questions.
recommended.example_value: Kitchen remodels, bathroom remodels, basement finishing, whole-home renovations, additions

recommended.why: Reno emergencies (active leak, structural collapse) happen off-hours. Sets what the agent says after business hours.
If after_hours_behavior=route_emergency, the agent gives this number for urgent calls.

recommended.display_name: What to do when the agent doesn't know
recommended.why: Defines the agent's fallback when KB returns nothing. take_message vs transfer vs find_out_callback.
Reno leads need address + scope at minimum. Determines what the agent asks before routing.
recommended.example_value: name, phone, project_type, address, timeline, budget_range

recommended_kb_topics.why: Asked on ~40% of reno calls. Without a KB entry, the agent must always route.
recommended_kb_topics.example_question: What kind of warranty do you offer on your work?
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'We offer X years on labor, Y years on materials. <owner_name> can walk you through the specifics.'

recommended_kb_topics.why: Common question for kitchen/bathroom/basement renos involving structural or electrical changes.
recommended_kb_topics.example_question: Do you guys pull the building permits for me?
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'Permits are handled as part of the project scope. <owner_name> can confirm whether your specific job needs one.'

recommended_kb_topics.why: Asked on most pricing calls. Better to have a canned answer than route every time.
recommended_kb_topics.example_question: Do you guys offer financing or payment plans?
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'We work with a few financing partners. <owner_name> can walk you through the options that fit your project.'

recommended_kb_topics.why: Cautious callers ask this. WCB/liability/property coverage.
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'Yes — we carry full liability and WCB coverage. <owner_name> can email you the certificates.'

recommended_kb_topics.why: Most clients want to know if there's a designer involved before they call back.
recommended_kb_topics.example_question: Do you guys do the design or do I need to bring my own?
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'Most projects start with a design consult — <owner_name> can walk you through how that works.'

recommended_kb_topics.why: Asked on most quote calls. Better to have a canned answer than route every time.
recommended_kb_topics.example_question: How do you structure payments? Deposit upfront?
recommended_kb_topics.example_answer_template: Most owners say: 'It varies by project size. <owner_name> can walk you through the schedule when he discusses the quote.'

recommended_business_facts.example_value: Family-owned since 2009 — over 400 completed renovations in the Calgary area.

recommended_business_facts.why: Helps the agent answer 'what do you guys do?' with personality, not just a list.
recommended_business_facts.example_value: We're a full-service residential renovation contractor — kitchens, bathrooms, basements, and whole-home renos in Calgary and surrounding areas.

recommended_business_facts.why: Helps the agent qualify scope-out calls (e.g. caller mentions $5K powder room — let's see if that fits).
recommended_business_facts.example_value: Most projects fall between $25K-$150K. We focus on mid-to-high-end residential.

niche_variables.why: First thing every caller hears. Sets tone.
niche_variables.default_value: Hi, thanks for calling {{BUSINESS_NAME}} — this is {{AGENT_NAME}}, how can I help you today?

niche_variables.why: What the agent says when handing off to <owner>. Repeated frequently.
niche_variables.default_value: I'll have {{CLOSE_PERSON}} call you back as soon as he can — usually within a couple hours during business days.

niche_variables.why: Tells the agent which words/phrases mean 'flag this as urgent' (active leak, structural, etc.).
niche_variables.default_value: water leak, sewage, structural, collapse, fire damage, post-storm, gas leak, mold spreading
